transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we need to complete our annual emergency evacuation exercise during the fall term, and I'll be giving final approval to the plan. I've reviewed the draft, which calls for a standard evacuation alarm, assembly in the east courtyard, and a general family notice. Before I can approve it, school policy requires that I review the plan with the nurse, counselor, facilities manager, and family liaison. So I'd like to go through the plan together and hear any concerns or suggestions from each of you.
